Subject: Azure Marketplace listing — initial ask

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking a look at ACME's plans to publish our new managed data connector on Azure Marketplace and to pursue the co-sell motion. We want to make sure we capture the right artifacts up front so your validation and marketplace team don't have to come back with follow-ups.

Quick background: this will be a SaaS offer (bring-your-own-subscription for customers) with meter-based billing. We're targeting a Sept marketplace publish date. Procurement for commercial terms is Lindsey (copied on this thread).

Could you share the exact set of technical and identity artifacts Redwood needs for the publisher account + offer creation? Specifically:
- The identity proofing docs you require for publisher ownership
- What you need for the manifest and SKU mapping for SaaS offers
- Security/compliance evidence items you want for co-sell (SOC2, logging/audit descriptions, data residency statements, network topology)
- Any suggested timeline for technical validation and the co-sell enablement checklist

Happy to attach what we already have — I can send the security pack and subscription statement.

Thanks,
Paul

Head of Partnerships, ACME Cloud Solutions
paul.hart@acmecloud.com

Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace listing — initial ask

Hi Paul — great to meet you and congrats on the product launch plan. I put together a concise mutual action plan (MAP) below so you can see which artifacts map to which gate. I'll also attach a lightweight Excel MAP template for you to fill in.

High-level gates and required artifacts:
1) Publisher account identity proofing (initial) — required: company legal entity docs, authorized signer name + email, tenant ID for the Azure publisher account.
2) Offer manifest + SKU mapping (tech) — required: sample offer JSON, SKU definitions, expected traffic profile (avg RPS, burst), and any 3rd-party dependency notes.
3) Security & compliance evidence (co-sell readiness) — required: SOC 2 Type II summary, pen-test summary or remediation plan, data handling summary (where customer data is stored/transit), authentication model (SAML/OIDC), and contact for security questionnaire.
4) Technical validation call — we do a 60–90 minute runthrough with our validation engineer to verify endpoints, entitlement checks, and subscription mapping.
5) Marketplace publish + co-sell opt-in — legal/commerce confirm manifest + pricing; Marketplace ops completes the publish window.

Suggested timeline (based on typical flows):
- Week 0: Identity proofing + initial docs received
- Week 1–2: Offer manifest and SKU review, security evidence review
- Week 3: Technical validation call and remediation
- Week 4: Marketplace publish window (assuming no major issues)

Action items for ACME from our side:
- Attach: publisher legal entity PDF, authorized signer info, tenant ID (GUID)
- Share: draft offer JSON (manifest), SKU mapping spreadsheet, traffic estimates
- Send: security evidence (SOC2 summary + pen test notes) — thanks for sending that already.

I'll own coordinating the technical validation with our infra/validation team. Looping in Marissa and Karthik for manifest/marketplace ops and billing questions. Marissa — can you confirm the latest manifest schema we should expect (v3) and any recent changes to SKU attributes? Karthik — I'll need your input on co-sell enrollment steps and whether we should pre-request a CSMP (co-sell marketing plan) from ACME.

I'll attach the MAP template: redwood_offer_map.xlsx

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai

A couple of clarifications:

Available times for the technical validation call: Wed Jul 10 or Thu Jul 11 (9–11am PT).

Cheers,
Paul

Paul — perfect, this puts us in a good place to schedule validation. Quick replies inline:
- Storage/regions: US-West control plane + US-East backups is fine for the Marketplace listing; we'll note the storage region in the offer metadata and flag it for customers who filter by residency. Irene — will you confirm if any additional data residency proof is needed for co-sell?
- SKU naming: keep SKU IDs short (alphanumeric, no spaces) and include a human-friendly displayName in the manifest for billing lines. Avoid special characters in the ID. Marissa — I'll need the canonical attribute list we validate against (billingDimensions, includedUnits, displayName).

Next steps / owners: 
- ACME: upload manifest draft and SKU spreadsheet to the Drive link (Paul) — target: EOD Thu Jul 4
- Redwood: confirm manifest schema and enumerate quick validation tests (Marissa) — target: Mon Jul 8
- Schedule technical validation call for Jul 10, 10am PT — I'll send a calendar invite after Lindsey confirms
- Legal/procurement: Lindsey to share authorized signer for publisher activation (ACME)

Paul — thanks for the SOC2 pack. I'll drop a short checklist of items we typically review during the validation call so your engineers can be prepared (service endpoints, entitlement mapping, sample jwt tokens, subscription test flow).

If Lindsey prefers, we can run a parallel legal onboarding thread to accelerate publisher activation.

Thanks all — looking forward to the call.

-Tessa
